paragraphs.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

i18n.en: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

paragraphs.text: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיָשֻׁ֗בוּ וְיַחֲנוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת בֵּ֥ין מִגְדֹּ֖ל וּבֵ֣ין הַיָּ֑ם לִפְנֵי֙ בַּ֣עַל צְפֹ֔ן נִכְח֥וֹ תַחֲנ֖וּ עַל־הַיָּֽם׃

i18n.en: "Speak to the children of Yisra'el, that they turn back and camp before Pi-haChirot, between Migdol and the sea; before Baal-Tzefon, opposite it, you shall camp by the sea.

paragraphs.text: וְאָמַ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְבֻכִ֥ים הֵ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ סָגַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

i18n.en: And Pharaoh will say of the children of Yisra'el, 'They are wandering confused in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.'

paragraphs.text: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֣י אֶת־לֵב־פַּרְעֹה֮ וְרָדַ֣ף אַחֲרֵיהֶם֒ וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־חֵיל֔וֹ וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־כֵֽן׃

i18n.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and he will pursue them; and I will be glorified through Pharaoh and through all his army, and the Egyptians shall know that I am YHWH." And they did so.

paragraphs.commentary: *wĕ-ḥizzaqtî ʾeṯ-lēḇ par'ōh* 'I will harden Pharaoh's heart' — explicit YHWH-as-agent statement of the hardening-of-Pharaoh's-heart pattern; see the central entry `hardening-of-pharaoh-heart-quishah-lev-ex-7-14-divine-action-theological-problem-cross-corpus` for the mixed-agency theological-problem and the Childs 1974 classic treatment. *ʾikkāḇḏâ bĕ-p̄ar'ōh* 'I will be glorified through Pharaoh' deploys the kavod-YHWH root in the divine-warrior-victory register; see the existing entry `kavod-yhwh`.

paragraphs.text: וַיֻּגַּד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח הָעָ֑ם וַ֠יֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַ֨ב פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַעֲבָדָיו֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּֽאמרוּ֙ מַה־זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־שִׁלַּ֥חְנוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעָבְדֵֽנוּ׃

i18n.en: And it was told to the king of Mitsrayim that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, "What is this we have done, that we have sent Yisra'el away from serving us?"

paragraphs.text: וַיֶּאְסֹ֖ר אֶת־רִכְבּ֑וֹ וְאֶת־עַמּ֖וֹ לָקַ֥ח עִמּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And he harnessed his chariot and took his people with him.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקַּ֗ח שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת רֶ֙כֶב֙ בָּח֔וּר וְכֹ֖ל רֶ֣כֶב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁלִשִׁ֖ם עַל־כֻּלּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And he took six hundred choice chariots, and all the chariots of Mitsrayim, and officers over every one of them.

paragraphs.text: וַיְחַזֵּ֣ק יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־לֵ֤ב פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֹצְאִ֖ים בְּיָ֥ד רָמָֽה׃

i18n.en: And YHWH hardened the heart of Pharaoh, king of Mitsrayim, and he pursued after the children of Yisra'el; but the children of Yisra'el were going out with a high hand.

paragraphs.commentary: Second YHWH-as-agent hardening-statement; see the central entry.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיַּשִּׂ֤יגוּ אוֹתָם֙ חֹנִ֣ים עַל־הַיָּ֔ם כָּל־סוּס֙ רֶ֣כֶב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו וְחֵיל֑וֹ עַל־פִּי֙ הַֽחִירֹ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י בַּ֥עַל צְפֹֽן׃

i18n.en: And the Egyptians pursued after them — all the horses of the chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army — and overtook them camping by the sea, beside Pi-haChirot, before Baal-Tzefon.

paragraphs.text: וּפַרְעֹ֖ה הִקְרִ֑יב וַיִּשְׂאוּ֩ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶ֜ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִצְרַ֣יִם ׀ נֹסֵ֣עַ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיִּֽירְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And as Pharaoh drew near, the children of Yisra'el lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid, and the children of Yisra'el cried out to YHWH.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֒ הַֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־קְבָרִים֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם לְקַחְתָּ֖נוּ לָמ֣וּת בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר מַה־זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔נוּ לְהוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And they said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Mitsrayim that you have taken us to die in the wilderness? What is this you have done to us, in bringing us out of Mitsrayim?

paragraphs.text: הֲלֹא־זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבַּ֨רְנוּ אֵלֶ֤יךָ בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חֲדַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְנַֽעַבְדָ֣ה אֶת־מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם מִמֻּתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

i18n.en: Is this not the word that we spoke to you in Mitsrayim, saying, 'Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians'? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־הָעָם֮ אַל־תִּירָאוּ֒ הִֽתְיַצְב֗וּ וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר רְאִיתֶ֤ם אֶת־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹ֥א תֹסִ֛יפוּ לִרְאֹתָ֥ם ע֖וֹד עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to the people, "Do not fear. Stand firm and see the deliverance of YHWH which he will work for you today; for the Egyptians whom you have seen today, you shall never see them again forever.

paragraphs.commentary: Moses' speech *ʾal-tîrāʾû hityaṣṣəḇû ū-rĕʾû ʾeṯ-yĕšûʿaṯ YHWH* 'do not fear, stand firm and see the deliverance of YHWH' deploys the *ʾal-tîrāʾ* fear-not encouragement-formula and sets up the v-14 divine-warrior formula. See the existing entry `al-tira-fear-not-divine-encouragement-formula`.

paragraphs.text: יְהוָ֖ה יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּ֖ם תַּחֲרִישֽׁוּן׃ (פ)

i18n.en: YHWH will fight for you, and you shall be silent."

paragraphs.commentary: **The divine-warrior formula locus-classicus**: *YHWH yillāḥēm lāḵem wĕ-ʾattem taḥărîšûn* 'YHWH will fight for you and you shall be silent'. See the central entry `yhwh-yilachem-lakhem-divine-warrior-formula-ex-14-13-14-cross-corpus` for the cross-corpus reach to Ex 15:3, Josh 10:14, Ps 24:8, Isa 42:13 and the Miller 1973 *The Divine Warrior in Early Israel* foundational treatment.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה־תִּצְעַ֖ק אֵלָ֑י דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיִסָּֽעוּ׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Why do you cry out to me? Speak to the children of Yisra'el, that they go forward.

paragraphs.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת־מַטְּךָ֗ וּנְטֵ֧ה אֶת־יָדְךָ֛ עַל־הַיָּ֖ם וּבְקָעֵ֑הוּ וְיָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃

i18n.en: And you, lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and split it, that the children of Yisra'el may come into the midst of the sea on dry ground.

paragraphs.commentary: **THE PARTING OF THE SEA initiation-verse.** The staff-stretched-out-and-split-the-sea protocol; the *bqʿ* 'to split, cleave' verb (cross-corpus to the chaoskampf tradition at Ps 74:13 *ʾattâ p̄ôrartā bĕ-ʿozkā yām*). See the central entry `keriat-yam-suf-parting-of-the-sea-ex-14-divine-warrior-cross-corpus-with-disavowals` for the three preserved reading-strata (mainstream Jewish-Christian theological miracle-of-deliverance; naturalistic-academic east-wind-tidal-event at the Bitter-Lakes shallow yam-suf; Raëlian-canon engineered-hydrodynamic-atmospheric-demonstration) and the operational disavowals.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִ֤י מְחַזֵּק֙ אֶת־לֵ֣ב מִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָבֹ֖אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־חֵיל֔וֹ בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

i18n.en: And I — behold, I am hardening the heart of the Egyptians, and they will come in after them; and I will be glorified through Pharaoh and through all his army, through his chariots and through his horsemen.

paragraphs.commentary: Continued *ḥzq* 'to harden' agency: *hinĕnî mĕḥazzēq* 'behold, I am hardening' — the participial-present construction emphasizes the ongoing-active hardening.

paragraphs.text: וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּהִכָּבְדִ֣י בְּפַרְעֹ֔ה בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

i18n.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am YHWH, when I am glorified through Pharaoh, through his chariots, and through his horsemen."

paragraphs.text: וַיִּסַּ֞ע מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים הַהֹלֵךְ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּסַּ֞ע עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֖ד מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And the messenger of the Elohim, who was going before the camp of Yisra'el, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them and stood behind them.

paragraphs.commentary: **The pillar-and-malakh redeployment**: the *malʾaḵ hā-ʾĕlōhîm* and the pillar-of-cloud move from before Israel to behind, interposing between the camps. The malakh-Elohim and the pillar are functionally identified — both are modes of the localized-divine-presence-manifestation (Sommer 2009). See the central entries `pillar-of-cloud-and-fire-ammud-ha-anan-ve-esh-divine-presence-marker-cross-corpus` and `burning-bush-malakh-YHWH-theophany-ex-3-2-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֞א בֵּ֣ין ׀ מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֗יִם וּבֵין֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְהִ֤י הֶֽעָנָן֙ וְהַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וַיָּ֖אֶר אֶת־הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְלֹא־קָרַ֥ב זֶ֛ה אֶל־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הַלָּֽיְלָה׃

i18n.en: And it came between the camp of Mitsrayim and the camp of Yisra'el; and there was the cloud and the darkness, yet it lit up the night; and the one did not come near the other all night.

paragraphs.commentary: The textually-difficult MT *wa-yhî he-ʿānān wĕ-ha-ḥōšeḵ wa-yāʾer ʾeṯ-ha-laylâ* 'there was the cloud and the darkness, yet it lit up the night' is preserved per the MT; the LXX harmonizing reading and the Rashi 'darkness for Egypt / light for Israel' midrashic gloss are documented in the apparatus.

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת־יָדוֹ֮ עַל־הַיָּם֒ וַיּ֣וֹלֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה ׀ אֶת־הַ֠יָּם בְּר֨וּחַ קָדִ֤ים עַזָּה֙ כָּל־הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם לֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיִּבָּקְע֖וּ הַמָּֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and YHWH drove back the sea by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea into dry land, and the waters were split apart.

paragraphs.commentary: **The strong-east-wind operative-mechanism**: *bĕ-rûaḥ qāḏîm ʿazzâ kol-ha-laylâ* 'by a strong east wind all night'. The east-wind agency is preserved on the surface; the naturalistic-academic east-wind-tidal-event reading (Hoffmeier 2005) concentrates here. The waters-split-apart *wa-yibbāqʿû ha-mmāyim* deploys the *bqʿ* chaoskampf-vocabulary.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el went into the midst of the sea on dry ground, and the waters were a wall for them on their right and on their left.

paragraphs.commentary: **The wall-of-water imagery**: *wĕ-ha-mayim lāhem ḥōmâ mî-mînām ū-mi-śmōʾlām* 'the waters were a wall for them on their right and on their left'. The literal *ḥōmâ* 'wall' is preserved on the surface; the cross-corpus echo at Josh 3:13-17 (the Jordan-stoppage at the entry into the Land) deploys the same wall-of-water imagery.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל ס֣וּס פַּרְעֹ֔ה רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֑יו אֶל־תּ֖וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃

i18n.en: And the Egyptians pursued and went in after them — all the horses of Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen — into the midst of the sea.

paragraphs.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בְּאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּשְׁקֵ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ וְעָנָ֑ן וַיָּ֕הָם אֵ֖ת מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass, in the morning watch, that YHWH looked down on the camp of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and threw the camp of the Egyptians into panic.

paragraphs.commentary: YHWH looks down from the pillar of fire and cloud in the *ʾašmōreṯ ha-bōqer* 'morning watch' (the third night-watch). The pillar's surveillance-function deploys the divine-presence-marker in a divine-warrior register.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֗סַר אֵ֚ת אֹפַ֣ן מַרְכְּבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֖הוּ בִּכְבֵדֻ֑ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִצְרַ֗יִם אָנ֙וּסָה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֥ם לָהֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And he removed the wheels of their chariots and made them drive heavily; and the Egyptians said, "Let us flee from before Yisra'el, for YHWH fights for them against Mitsrayim."

paragraphs.commentary: The MT *wa-yāsar ʾēṯ ʾōp̄an markĕḇōṯāyw* 'he removed the wheels of their chariots' is preserved; the LXX/Samaritan/Syriac variant 'he clogged/bound the wheels' is documented as a textual-variant. The Egyptian acknowledgment *YHWH nilḥām lāhem bĕ-miṣrāyim* 'YHWH fights for them against Mitsrayim' is the explicit-divine-warrior recognition; see the central entry `yhwh-yilachem-lakhem-divine-warrior-formula-ex-14-13-14-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה נְטֵ֥ה אֶת־יָדְךָ֖ עַל־הַיָּ֑ם וְיָשֻׁ֤בוּ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ עַל־מִצְרַ֔יִם עַל־רִכְבּ֖וֹ וְעַל־פָּרָשָֽׁיו׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may return upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots and upon their horsemen."

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־יָד֜וֹ עַל־הַיָּ֗ם וַיָּ֨שָׁב הַיָּ֜ם לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּ֙קֶר֙ לְאֵ֣יתָנ֔וֹ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם נָסִ֣ים לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַיְנַעֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and at the turning of morning the sea returned to its strength, and the Egyptians were fleeing into it; and YHWH overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

paragraphs.commentary: The *yenaer* 'shook off / overthrew' verb (Piʿel of *nʿr*); the WoH-Translation preserves 'overthrew' per the ASV-standard, with the literal 'shook off' documented.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיְכַסּ֤וּ אֶת־הָרֶ֙כֶב֙ וְאֶת־הַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים לְכֹל֙ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֔ה הַבָּאִ֥ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם בַּיָּ֑ם לֹֽא־נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּהֶ֖ם עַד־אֶחָֽד׃

i18n.en: And the waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen — the entire army of Pharaoh that had come into the sea after them; not one of them remained.

paragraphs.text: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיָּ֑ם וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃

i18n.en: But the children of Yisra'el walked on dry ground in the midst of the sea, and the waters were a wall for them on their right and on their left.

paragraphs.text: וַיּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֜ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֛וּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיַּ֤רְא יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ֖ת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּֽם׃

i18n.en: And YHWH delivered Yisra'el on that day from the hand of Mitsrayim; and Yisra'el saw the Egyptians dead on the shore of the sea.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּ֨רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַיָּ֣ד הַגְּדֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽאֲמִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבְמֹשֶׁ֖ה עַבְדּֽוֹ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And Yisra'el saw the great hand which YHWH had wrought against Mitsrayim, and the people feared YHWH, and they believed in YHWH and in Moses his servant.

paragraphs.commentary: *ha-yyāḏ ha-gĕḏōlâ* 'the great hand' — the divine-warrior-victory-formula closing the chapter. The people's response *wa-yyaʾămînû ba-YHWH ū-ḇĕ-mōšê ʿaḇdô* 'they believed in YHWH and in Moses his servant' establishes the Moses-as-divine-servant institutional grounding for the subsequent prophetic-mediator tradition.
